answer: The design leans on time-locked work history, revoked by a single upheld challenge, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The dune of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Each submission hangs on the violet of a task receipt, and the inlet is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
